name: DRAGON MASTER Silk II
original_name: ドラゴンマスターシルク2
source:
In this sequel to Dragon Master Silk: Ryū Shōkan Musume, the young Silk and her minions, the three cute, sexy elemental dragon girls Ao, Aka, and Ki are joined by a new dragon girl - Ruli, the purple-haired Dragon of Wisdom. The team shows the new recruit the cave with the sealed evil dragon - but an unfortunate accident breaks the seal, monsters invade the land, and our heroines have to save it once again, venturing into deep and dangerous dungeons...

Dragon Master Silk II plays very similarly to the previous game, one notable exception being the extra party member (Ruli). Most of the game takes place in first-person maze-like dungeons. Enemies appear randomly. It is possible to set the party on auto, assign general strategies ("don't use magic", etc.), or control every party member individually. The party can visit the town to buy items and rest.

Typically for the series, Dragon Master Silk II features "super-deformed" graphics, humorous dialogues and situations. There are plenty of scantily dressed young girls and sexual innuendo in the game, but no explicit nudity or sex scenes.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/44038/dragon-master-silk-ii/]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
在《龙主丝绸：龙翔馆娘》的续集中，年轻的丝绸和她的爪牙，三个可爱、性感的元素龙女青、阿卡和基，以及一个新的龙女 - 紫发智慧龙如莉。团队向新兵展示了被封印的邪龙的洞穴 - 但一场不幸的事故打破了封印，怪物入侵了这片土地，我们的女主角必须再次拯救它，冒险进入深邃而危险的地牢……

Dragon Master Silk II的玩法与前一款游戏非常相似，一个值得注意的例外是额外的党员（Ruli）。游戏的大部分内容都发生在第一人称迷宫般的地下城中。敌人随机出现。可以将队伍设置为自动，分配一般策略（“不要使用魔法”等），或单独控制每个队伍成员。队伍可以到城镇里购买物品并休息。

《龙主丝绸II》具有该系列的典型特征，具有“超级变形”的图形、幽默的对话和场景。游戏中有大量衣着暴露的年轻女孩和性暗示，但没有明显的裸体或性爱场景。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/44038/dragon-master-silk-ii/]Moby Games[/url]]
